facts.value: Emergency rescue and firefighting authority. Responds to fires, building collapses, floods, chemical/gas hazards, traffic accident rescue, mountain/sea rescue, entrapment, and mass casualty incidents. Always first responder for any life-safety emergency. Coordinates with ISF and MPWT after scene is secured. Complaint domains encoded for routing: fire_in_building, fire_public_area, building_collapse, flood_rescue, trapped_person, chemical_hazard, gas_leak, road_accident_rescue, mountain_rescue, sea_rescue, entrapment, mass_casualty, hazardous_material_spill, electrical_fire, substation_fire, landfill_fire.

Not responsible for / boundary conditions: crime_investigation(ISF); infrastructure_repair_after_emergency(MUN_MPWT); water_electricity_restoration_after_emergency(EDL_RWA); non_emergency_administrative_complaints; post_emergency_grid_repair; Route instead to EDL_OR_EDZ_BY_LOCATION when Civil Defense handles emergency safety not utility restoration.; post_emergency_repair_or_road_maintenance; Route instead to MUN_OR_MPWT when Civil Defense handles emergency response not ordinary repairs.; post_fire_cleanup_or_routine_waste_removal; Route instead to MUN_OR_MOE when Civil Defense is emergency response not cleanup authority.; post_emergency_repair_cleanup_or_local_enforcement; Route instead to MUN_OR_RELEVANT_ASSET_OWNER when Civil Defense handles emergency response not routine repairs.
facts.notes: Runtime cases may still require HITL when asset ownership, location, or public/private responsibility is ambiguous.

facts.value: Geographic scope: national_with_centers. Emergency response first then technical follow-up with infrastructure owner. Call Civil Defense first if immediate public danger and route grid isolation to EDL or EDZ by location. Civil Defense first for scene safety then EDL or EDZ for grid equipment isolation and repair. Civil Defense is first for active fire or smoke danger; municipality/MOE follow after scene safety. Civil Defense first for fire explosion gas rescue and active life-safety danger; ISF if security or traffic control is needed.
